notes: blended over 7 economies for market scope 'Global': br 5%, ch 5%, cn 25%, de 15%, fr 10%, gb 10%, us 30%. The blend is a weighted sum of per-economy distributions, per period.

the window 2010-01 to 2024-12 spans 180 months and carries 177. Its start is set by br (which begins 2010-01) and its end by cn (which ends 2024-12). A backtest cannot run longer than this. It is NOT contiguous: 3 month(s) are absent because the blend requires every contributor in a period and drops the period otherwise, so any one contributor's gap is the blend's gap. Absent: 2013-11..2013-12 (2 months); 2014-02. A backtest cannot run through these either, and a statistic bucketed by state will be short by exactly these months.
each contributing distribution is an annual macro assessment held flat within its year, blended with a monthly technical signal. All intra-year variation is technical.

computed under python 3.12.10, numpy 2.5.1, scipy 1.18.0, pandas 3.0.5, statsmodels 0.14.6. The identifiers above are content hashes, so they move when this stack moves even though the model version does not: the arithmetic changed, not the model.
the contributing economies are in different capital-cycle phases ([2, 4]), so the blend has no single phase and none is reported. That disagreement is a finding about the scope, not a defect.

provenance.blend: weighted sum of per-economy distributions per period
provenance.macro_to_monthly: step hold within each year, no interpolation
